question: Should pending Skill Workshop approvals be bound to the reviewed proposal version so a revision requires the operator to review and approve again, rather than allowing an older prompt to act on newer content?
rationale: This is an intentional operator-facing safety and compatibility choice, not a mechanical correctness defect: the patch preserves direct ID-only calls but changes what happens after a proposal changes during a pending approval.

options.title: Adopt reviewed-version binding
options.body: Keep the fail-closed pending-approval contract, require a fresh review after revisions, and refresh the branch with focused regression proof.

options.title: Keep pending approvals version-agnostic
options.body: Retain legacy approval behavior so an existing prompt can act on the latest pending proposal, accepting the weaker review-to-apply coupling.

recommendation.title: Adopt reviewed-version binding
recommendation.body: Keep the fail-closed pending-approval contract, require a fresh review after revisions, and refresh the branch with focused regression proof.
